concern_summary: This concern is centered on the creation and validation of distance waypoints for expense requests, ensuring sufficient distinct waypoints are provided while managing errors related to the waypoint collection.

This concern pertains to the management and validation of waypoints in transactions, including checks for pending waypoints, their retrieval from the server, and validations for processing distance-related requests.
This concern encompasses the management of collections of waypoints, including sorting, validating, updating, and ensuring the correct number of waypoints for distance-related processing.
This concern focuses on the creation, validation, and management of individual waypoints within transactions, enabling the users to add, edit, and remove specific waypoint locations.
Management and processing of distance-related expenses, including receipt generation and tax reclaimable calculations based on distance rates.
This concern addresses the evaluation of error conditions related to route management in a transaction, including the detection of route errors and validation of waypoint requirements.
This concern involves handling updates to transactions that include changes to waypoints, ensuring that associated calculations and formats are correct when routes or rates are modified.
Display and management of distance data on maps, including rendering waypoints and handling geographical information relevant to transactions.
Calculation of navigation-related distances in user paths and navigation states, influencing navigation behavior.
